blogs.title: How DeepSeekMath Built a 120B-Token Math Corpus from the Web
blogs.description: A behind-the-scenes walkthrough of the DeepSeekMath Corpus: how the team used a fastText classifier, iterative domain mining, deduplication, human annotation and benchmark decontamination on Common Crawl to extract 120B math tokens. Ideal for data engineers and ML students who want practical lessons for creating high-quality domain corpora from noisy web data.

blogs.title: Why a 7B Model Can Rival a 540B Model for Math: The Power of Data and Curriculum
blogs.description: An accessible analysis of DeepSeekMath's surprising result: a 7B model competitive with much larger closed models. Covers the role of targeted pretraining data, code-first initialization, mixed data distributions, and what this implies for cost-effective model development and research priorities.

blogs.title: Code Training Improves Mathematical Reasoning — Here's Why (and How to Do It)
blogs.description: Explains the experiments showing code pretraining helps both program-aided and chain-of-thought math reasoning. Compares two-stage vs one-stage training, discusses catastrophic forgetting, and gives practical tips for practitioners who want to mix code and math data effectively.

blogs.title: GRPO — A Lightweight RL Trick That Boosts Math Skills Without a Critic
blogs.description: Demystifies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for a general audience: how it replaces a learned critic with group-based baselines, why that saves memory and stabilizes training, and the difference between outcome vs process supervision. Includes intuition, visual metaphors, and when to consider GRPO over PPO.

blogs.title: From SFT to RL: A Unified Paradigm to Align LLMs for Better Reasoning
blogs.description: Presents the paper's unified view tying together SFT, RFT, DPO, PPO and GRPO. Explains the three pillars—data source, reward function, algorithm—and how each choice shapes model updates. Useful for researchers and engineers designing alignment or RL pipelines for reasoning tasks.

blogs.title: Practical Guide: Instruction-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning for Math LLMs
blogs.description: A hands-on post with recommended SFT datasets, sampling strategies, reward-model construction, hyperparameter tips (group sizes, KL settings, batch sizes), and evaluation practices drawn from DeepSeekMath. Focused on reproducibility and common pitfalls for ML practitioners attempting math-focused fine-tuning and RL.

blogs.title: What We Learned About arXiv: Why Research Papers Might Not Help Math Benchmarks
blogs.description: Summarizes the paper's counterintuitive finding that arXiv-heavy data did not improve (and sometimes hurt) math benchmark performance. Discusses possible reasons, limitations of the experiments, and guidance on when and how to include research papers in domain pretraining.

blogs.title: Limitations and Next Steps for Open-Source Math LLMs
blogs.description: An honest overview of DeepSeekMath's shortcomings (geometry/theorem weaknesses, few-shot limitations, potential data biases) and a forward-looking discussion of research directions: better reward models, robust RL against noisy rewards, advanced sampling and decoding strategies, and improved dataset diversity.
